newsitem.title: UK: UK shares up after results, look to retail prices.
newsitem.headline: UK shares up after results, look to retail prices.

text.p: London shares opened higher on Thursday as the market got to grips with one of the busiest days of the year for corporate results, dealers said.
Early trading was dominated by the string of company news, as the market move to digest figures from over 40 companies, including seven from the FTSE 100.
By 0738 GMT, the leading shares' index had edged 9.1 points higher to 3,914.7 but trading was expected to remain cautious ahead of key economic data from both the UK and U.S.
UK retail prices are due at 0830 GMT and forecast to rise 0.4 percent for the month and 2.1 percent year-on-year.
